title: MORNING + EVENING PROTECTION
bullets: Recite al-Ikhlāṣ, al-Falaq, and an-Nās three times in the morning and three times in the evening.
These are Qur'an recitations and dhikr, not a separate salah.
Learn each surah accurately and use them consistently.
reflection: “Surely in the remembrance of Allah do hearts find rest.”

title: PROTECTION BEFORE SLEEP
bullets: Recite al-Ikhlāṣ, al-Falaq, and an-Nās.
Blow lightly into the cupped hands.
Wipe over as much of the body as you can, beginning with the head and front of the body.
Repeat the sequence three times.
Also recite Ayat al-Kursi before sleep.

title: DUʿA OF YUNUS IN DISTRESS
arabic: لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنْتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
translit: Lā ilāha illā Anta, subḥānaka innī kuntu mina ẓ-ẓālimīn.
meaning: There is no deity except You. Glory be to You. I have indeed been among the wrongdoers.
source: Qur'an 21:87; Jamiʿ at-Tirmidhi 3505 on this supplication.

title: FOR A RIGHTEOUS SPOUSE + FAMILY
arabic: رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَاجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا
translit: Rabbanā hab lanā min azwājinā wa dhurriyyātinā qurrata aʿyunin wa-jʿalnā lil-muttaqīna imāmā.
meaning: Our Lord, grant us from our spouses and offspring comfort to our eyes, and make us examples for the righteous.

title: ASKING ALLAH FOR ANY GOOD
arabic: رَبِّ إِنِّي لِمَا أَنْزَلْتَ إِلَيَّ مِنْ خَيْرٍ فَقِيرٌ
translit: Rabbi innī limā anzalta ilayya min khayrin faqīr.
meaning: My Lord, I am truly in need of whatever good You send down to me.
note: This is broad: provision, opportunity, help, marriage, safety, and every form of lawful good can be asked from Allah.

title: GOOD IN THIS LIFE + THE NEXT
arabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً، وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً، وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
translit: Rabbanā ātinā fi d-dunyā ḥasanatan, wa fi l-ākhirati ḥasanatan, wa qinā ʿadhāba n-nār.
meaning: Our Lord, give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.
source: Qur'an 2:201; also among the Prophet’s frequent supplications.

title: GUIDANCE • PIETY • CHASTITY • SUFFICIENCY
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْهُدَى، وَالتُّقَى، وَالْعَفَافَ، وَالْغِنَى
translit: Allāhumma innī asʾaluka l-hudā, wa-t-tuqā, wa-l-ʿafāfa, wa-l-ghinā.
meaning: O Allah, I ask You for guidance, piety, chastity, and sufficiency.

title: FORGIVENESS • MERCY • GUIDANCE • HEALTH • PROVISION
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي، وَارْحَمْنِي، وَاهْدِنِي، وَعَافِنِي، وَارْزُقْنِي
translit: Allāhumma-ghfir lī, warḥamnī, wahdinī, wa ʿāfinī, warzuqnī.
meaning: O Allah, forgive me, have mercy on me, guide me, grant me well-being, and provide for me.

title: BENEFICIAL KNOWLEDGE + GOOD PROVISION
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْمًا نَافِعًا، وَرِزْقًا طَيِّبًا، وَعَمَلًا مُتَقَبَّلًا
translit: Allāhumma innī asʾaluka ʿilman nāfiʿan, wa rizqan ṭayyiban, wa ʿamalan mutaqabbalan.
meaning: O Allah, I ask You for beneficial knowledge, good lawful provision, and accepted deeds.
note: Reported as a supplication after the Fajr prayer.

title: FOR RIGHTEOUS CHILDREN
arabic: رَبِّ هَبْ لِي مِنْ لَدُنْكَ ذُرِّيَّةً طَيِّبَةً، إِنَّكَ سَمِيعُ الدُّعَاءِ
translit: Rabbi hab lī min ladunka dhurriyyatan ṭayyibah, innaka samīʿu d-duʿāʾ.
meaning: My Lord, grant me from Yourself righteous offspring. You are indeed the Hearer of prayer.

title: FOR YOUR PARENTS
arabic: رَبِّ ارْحَمْهُمَا كَمَا رَبَّيَانِي صَغِيرًا
translit: Rabbi rḥamhumā kamā rabbayānī ṣaghīrā.
meaning: My Lord, have mercy upon them as they raised me when I was small.

title: ANXIETY + DEBT
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْجُبْنِ وَالْبُخْلِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ غَلَبَةِ الدَّيْنِ وَقَهْرِ الرِّجَالِ
translit: Allāhumma innī aʿūdhu bika mina l-hammi wa-l-ḥazan, wa aʿūdhu bika mina l-ʿajzi wa-l-kasal, wa aʿūdhu bika mina l-jubni wa-l-bukhl, wa aʿūdhu bika min ghalabati d-dayni wa qahri r-rijāl.
meaning: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from anxiety and sorrow, helplessness and laziness, cowardice and miserliness, the burden of debt, and being overpowered by people.

title: DUʿA FOR HEALING
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ النَّاسِ، أَذْهِبِ الْبَأْسَ، اشْفِ أَنْتَ الشَّافِي، لَا شِفَاءَ إِلَّا شِفَاؤُكَ، شِفَاءً لَا يُغَادِرُ سَقَمًا
translit: Allāhumma Rabba n-nās, adhhibi l-baʾs, ishfi Anta sh-Shāfī, lā shifāʾa illā shifāʾuk, shifāʾan lā yughadiru saqaman.
meaning: O Allah, Lord of mankind, remove the harm and heal. You are the Healer. There is no healing except Your healing, a healing that leaves no illness behind.

title: DUʿA IN YOUR OWN WORDS
bullets: Outside formal salah, you may ask Allah directly for lawful needs in your own language.
You may ask for a righteous wife, children, work, provision, safety, a home, guidance, knowledge, forgiveness, success, protection, or any lawful good.
The Qur'an and Sunnah duʿās are especially valuable to learn, but Allah is not limited to memorized formulas.
Be specific, humble, persistent, and accept that Allah answers with perfect knowledge.
reflection: “I am near. I answer the call of the caller when he calls upon Me.”

title: BEST TIMES TO MAKE DUʿA
bullets: During sujud.
In the last third of the night.
Between the adhan and iqamah.
At the end of the prayer before salam with established supplications.
While fasting and at iftar.
On Friday there is an hour in which duʿā is especially hoped to be accepted; scholars differ over its exact placement.
source: Multiple authentic hadiths on times of duʿā.

title: LEAVING HOME
arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ، لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
translit: Bismi-llāh, tawakkaltu ʿala llāh, lā ḥawla wa lā quwwata illā billāh.
meaning: In the name of Allah; I rely upon Allah. There is no power and no strength except through Allah.

title: ENTERING HOME
bullets: Mention Allah’s name when entering.
Give salam to those in the home.
Mention Allah’s name when eating so Shaytan is denied lodging and food.

title: TRAVEL DUʿA
arabic: سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ، وَإِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا لَمُنْقَلِبُونَ
translit: Subḥāna lladhī sakhkhara lanā hādhā wa mā kunnā lahu muqrinīn, wa innā ilā Rabbinā la-munqalibūn.
meaning: Glory be to the One who subjected this to us though we could not have controlled it, and surely to our Lord we will return.
note: This is the Qur'anic opening of the longer Prophetic travel supplication.

title: BEFORE EATING
arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ
translit: Bismi-llāh.
meaning: In the name of Allah.
bullets: If you forgot at the beginning, say: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ أَوَّلَهُ وَآخِرَهُ — Bismi-llāhi awwalahu wa ākhirah.

title: AFTER EATING
arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنِي هَذَا وَرَزَقَنِيهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلَا قُوَّةٍ
translit: Al-ḥamdu lillāhi lladhī aṭʿamanī hādhā wa razaqanīhi min ghayri ḥawlin minnī wa lā quwwah.
meaning: All praise is for Allah who fed me this and provided it for me without any power or strength from me.

title: WHEN PUTTING ON CLOTHES
arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي كَسَانِي هَذَا وَرَزَقَنِيهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلَا قُوَّةٍ
translit: Al-ḥamdu lillāhi lladhī kasānī hādhā wa razaqanīhi min ghayri ḥawlin minnī wa lā quwwah.
meaning: All praise is for Allah who clothed me with this and provided it for me without any power or strength from me.

title: WHEN RAIN FALLS
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَيِّبًا نَافِعًا
translit: Allāhumma ṣayyiban nāfiʿā.
meaning: O Allah, make it beneficial rain.

title: WHEN YOU HEAR THUNDER
arabic: وَيُسَبِّحُ الرَّعْدُ بِحَمْدِهِ وَالْمَلَائِكَةُ مِنْ خِيفَتِهِ
translit: Wa yusabbiḥu r-raʿdu biḥamdihī wa-l-malāʾikatu min khīfatih.
meaning: The thunder glorifies Him with praise, and the angels from awe of Him.
note: This verse is a Qur'anic reminder. Reports also transmit personal dhikr of early Muslims when hearing thunder.

title: VISITING THE SICK
arabic: لَا بَأْسَ، طَهُورٌ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ
translit: Lā baʾsa, ṭahūrun in shāʾ Allāh.
meaning: No harm; may it be purification, if Allah wills.

title: ENTERING A GRAVEYARD
arabic: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ أَهْلَ الدِّيَارِ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُسْلِمِينَ، وَإِنَّا إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ بِكُمْ لَاحِقُونَ، نَسْأَلُ اللَّهَ لَنَا وَلَكُمُ الْعَافِيَةَ
translit: As-salāmu ʿalaykum ahla d-diyāri mina l-muʾminīna wa-l-muslimīn, wa innā in shāʾ Allāhu bikum lāḥiqūn. Nasʾalu llāha lanā wa lakumu l-ʿāfiyah.
meaning: Peace be upon you, inhabitants of these dwellings, believers and Muslims. We, if Allah wills, will join you. We ask Allah for well-being for us and for you.
